summary: Iter-407 — Zygoma/Pterygoid Implant Selection (v6). Backend + Frontend both PASS. Backend: 5/5 pytest cases green (Quad Zygoma 4-row POST/GET with new fields implant_type='zygoma'+side+row_label, >10 implants rejected, duplicate positions rejected, mixed zygoma+pterygoid+conventional payload). Frontend (mobile 390x844): specialised ZygomaImplantSelection renders for a Quad Zygoma case with 4 pre-populated rows (Right #1/#2, Left #1/#2), Add Implant modal shows only 'Select Zygoma Implant' card (single type card as expected for Quad Zygoma), Edit modal exposes Side chips Right/Left + Refirm Z-Series system + Diameter + Length + Update Implant button. FDI 'Add Implant Position' pill is NOT rendered for zygoma cases (add_pill: False). Regression confirmed on a Single Conventional Implant case — zygoma testIDs absent, standard FDI-based UI still active. Minor spec deviation: header text is 'Zygoma / Pterygoid Implant Selection' whereas the review request said 'Zygoma / Pterygoid Implant Planning' — cosmetic only. Pre-existing 'Unexpected text node' React Native web warnings observed on both zygoma and non-zygoma procedure detail pages — not introduced by this feature.

issues: Header renders 'Zygoma / Pterygoid Implant Selection'; review request expected 'Zygoma / Pterygoid Implant Planning'. Cosmetic only — code at frontend/components/ZygomaImplantSelection.tsx:123. Consider aligning label.
